purpose: validate real MAP01 v13 retained-input telemetry, independent scorer cadence, terminal score agreement, and one-shot launch ownership before any recovery-vs-coast efficacy allocation

launch_protocol.canonical_owner_rule: earliest run_number then run_id for exact workflow path and head SHA

pass_requires: canonical launch ownership before formal probe
normal two-key hold completes with verified direct release transitions
direct retained-input analyzer is measurement-ready with no unmatched or invalid releases
independent scorer has zero missed periods
exactly one direct final scorer sample
final scorer sample strictly equals score.json on map_exit, episode_finished, player_dead, death_count, kill_count
all terminal input release is verified empty
